boon.description: # While this card is recharging, you may add {Dc} to all Social actions involving the target.

conservative.requirements: Target can hear and understand you. Influence the target by telling him exactly what he wants to hear. If appropriate, you can sway the target towards a reasonable argument or convince him to agree to a reasonable request.

boon.description: While this card is recharging, you may add {Df} to all Social actions involving the target.

bane.description: While this card is recharging, add {Dm} to all Social actions involving the target.

reckless.requirements: Special: You lie to your target. A lot. If fooled, you can sway the target towards your side of the story or convince him to agree to a reasonable request.
